calls.reason: No poll in the packet measures trust in OpenAI itself, and nothing links distrust to lost business. The WSJ-sourced report shows revenue still up 18% and blames the slowdown on competition and pricing.

The polls conflict. Veleonis put OpenAI's net favorability at -41, while The Argument found +11 among voters who knew the company. No poll in the period asks directly about trust, so 'hardly anyone' can't be called.

The claim is hedged ('as far as I can tell'). The only evidence is Contrary Research saying 'some analysts' doubted the safety reason, while the same piece reported that reason at face value. Nothing measured the overall reaction.
WSJ figures, reported by Outlook Business and Enterprise, show the operating loss rose from $9.3B to $12.3B. That is about 32%, or 1.3 times, far short of quadrupling.
